title: Health Resort west wing room 321 safe key

infobox.usage: Unlocks a safe in room 321 of the West wing in the Health Resort on Shoreline.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Health Resort west wing room 321 safe key (W321 safe) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the Azure Coast sanatorium west wing room 321 safe.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Shoreline
sections.text: The key can be found in a locker in the weather station tower

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: The third floor, room 321 of the West Wing in the Health Resort on Shoreline.
